svg.title: Vanguard 15 sail insignia
svg.desc: Manual vector tracing of the crossed sails and 15 from the archived v15.org v15_logo_small.gif, preserved in v15-content/v15-oldsite and public/images/v15-logo.png. The surrounding circle and VANGUARD wordmark are omitted. This is a reconstructed insignia, not an official vector master.
